description: If youre looking for a three-row SUV that gives you upscale comfort, confident AWD capability, serious safety technology, and room for the whole family, this 2021 Hyundai Palisade Limited AWD checks all the right boxes. Finished in Typhoon Silver with a Black Nappa leather interior, the Limited trim is loaded with premium equipment that makes this Palisade feel far more luxurious than your typical family SUV. The original window sticker confirms the Limited AWD configuration and extensive factory equipment.  Under the hood is Hyundais 3.8L GDI V6 producing 291 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC paddle shifters. HTRAC AWD gives you extra confidence when the weather turns, while selectable drive modes, SNOW Mode, AWD Lock, and an auto-leveling rear suspension add capability for everyday driving, road trips, and changing conditions.  Inside is where the Limited really stands out. You get Nappa leather seating surfaces, heated AND ventilated first- and second-row seats, a heated steering wheel, dual sunroofs, ambient interior lighting, a suede-like Melange headliner, and an integrated memory drivers seat. The power-folding, unfolding, and reclining third row makes switching between passengers and cargo easy, while rear side-window sunshades and separate second-row climate controls help keep everyone comfortable.  Premium technology is everywhere, including a 12.3-inch full-digital instrument cluster, 10.25-inch navigation system, head-up display, Harman Kardon premium audio, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, wireless phone charging, seven USB outlets, and a 115-volt household-style power outlet. You also get Hyundais Driver Talk in-car intercom, Rear Seat Quiet Mode, HomeLink, and a hands-free smart liftgate with automatic opening.  Loaded With Features Youll Actually Appreciate Surround View Monitor gives you a birds-eye view when maneuvering in tight spaces. Blind View Monitor adds extra visibility when changing lanes. Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go and Highway Driving Assist make longer highway trips much more relaxing. LED headlights, taillights, and daytime running lights give it a sharp, upscale appearance. 20-inch alloy wheels complete the Limiteds premium exterior look. Front and rear parking sensors take some of the stress out of parking a three-row SUV. Roof-rack cross rails and a factory trailering package add useful versatility when its time for an adventure.  Safety is another major strength. This Palisade carries a 5-Star Overall Vehicle Score from NHTSA as shown on its original window sticker. It also came equipped with Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Following Assist, Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist, Safe Exit Assist, Driver Attention Warning, and an ultrasonic Rear Occupant Alert.  Ownership & Condition This is a 1-owner Palisade, making it an especially appealing choice for someone wanting a well-equipped pre-owned luxury SUV with straightforward ownership history. Beyond the luxury equipment, youre getting the practicality of three-row seating, AWD capability, a powerful naturally aspirated V6, and a long list of modern driver-assistance features. Kenne Bell Supercharged Camaro SS  Inferno Orange Leather  Only 56K Miles  WE FINANCE  Some cars really don't need much explaining.
